content: NIST TN 1297 states that a measurement result is complete only with a quantitative uncertainty statement and that reporting should identify uncertainty components and the basis for any confidence interpretation. For SukatAI this supports separating input/process quality, fit diagnostics, and independent reference validation; CLAD fit loss or pose confidence must not become a customer accuracy percentage. Until consented tape-measurement ground truth and a fixed evaluation protocol exist, keep confidence nullable and accuracy status explicitly unvalidated.
